meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 装好此技能后,Claude 可以按你的文字描述生成新图片,或对已有图片进行编辑(改背景、加元素等)。它会调用 OpenRouter 上的图像模型(如 Gemini 3.1 Flash、FLUX),并把结果保存为 PNG 文件。需要先配置 OpenRouter 的 API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑照片、插画、概念图等非技术图表类图片时触发。若需要流程图、电路图等示意图,则不会触发。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下的山景照片。
say.note: 会执行脚本并保存为 PNG。

say.text: 把这张图片的背景改成蓝色。
say.note: 将调用编辑模式修改图片。

say.text: 用 FLUX 模型生成一张简约风格的图标。
say.note: 可指定模型,需在话中提到。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can generate new images from text or edit existing ones (change background, add elements). It calls OpenRouter image models (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Flash, FLUX), saving the result as a PNG; an OpenRouter API key must be configured.
howto.when_en: When you ask to generate or edit photos, illustrations, concept art, or other non-technical images. For flowcharts, circuit diagrams, etc., it won't trigger and uses scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a mountain landscape at sunset.
say_en.note: Runs the script and saves a PNG.

say_en.text: Change the background of this image to blue.
say_en.note: Uses edit mode on the provided image.

say_en.text: Use FLUX model to generate a minimal style icon.
